desc: In compliance with Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with Schedule III of the Listing Regulations we hereby submit the outcome of the Meeting of Board of Directors was held today i.e. Saturday, 29th August, 2026 and inter-alia discussed/approved the Resolutions mentioned in the Outcome.

1. On Recommendation of the Audit Committee of the Company, approved the Re-appointment of Mr. Kinjal Shah, Practicing Company Secretaries, (Certificate of practice no. 21716 and Membership No. F7417) as Secretarial Auditors of the Company for the financial year 2026-27                                          2. On Recommendation of the Audit Committee of the Company, approved the Re-appointment of M/S. M.P. Sutaria & Co. as an Internal Auditor of the Company for the Financial Year 2026-27.
